name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Valanaar, Quel'ana Quickgale can teach you to tame a beast. Your time in the highlands has prepared you to seek an animal companion.

sections.title: A New Companion
sections.body: Your host believes you are ready to seek an animal companion after your time in the highlands. Go to Valanaar and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale. He will teach you the art of beast taming.

faq.answer: Quel'ana Quickgale teaches you to tame beasts in Valanaar.

faq.q: Where do I find Quel'ana Quickgale?
faq.answer: Quel'ana Quickgale is in Valanaar, the port to the southeast.

faq.q: Why am I going to Valanaar?
faq.answer: You are sent to Valanaar to speak with Quel'ana Quickgale and begin learning to tame beasts.
Quel'ana Quickgale will teach you to tame a beast so you can seek an animal companion.

attribution: In-game quest text: Taming the Beast
